SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-02: CQL — Types - Clinical. Test these items: Code type, CodeSystem type (CQL 1.5 trial-use), Concept type, ValueSet type (CQL 1.5 trial-use), Vocabulary type (CQL 1.5 trial-use). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B Types: ValueSet and CodeSystem derive from Vocabulary; Appendix B Is operator; Developer Guide Type Testing
issues.root_cause: Clinical parameter symbols were omitted from static clinical type inference, so typed clinical parameter values fell into generic runtime JSON resource checks.
issues.resolution: Clinical parameter symbols now feed `_static_clinical_type`, preserving declared Code/Concept/ValueSet/CodeSystem/Vocabulary metadata for `is`/`as` before generic FHIR resourceType probing.
issues.verified_in: CQL-02 probe; focused clinical parity pytest; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B ToConcept: ToConcept(Code) and ToConcept(List<Code>) return Concept; null returns null
issues.root_cause: The translator and DuckDB registration treated ToConcept as scalar-only even though the CQL surface accepts Code and List<Code>.
issues.resolution: Translated `ToConcept(List<Code>)` now routes to `ToConceptFromList`; Python fallback exposes a macro-backed ToConcept list surface and native C++ registers ToConcept(VARCHAR[]) plus ToConceptFromList(VARCHAR[]).
issues.verified_in: CQL-02 probe; focused clinical/conversion pytest; native sqllogictest 776 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5.3 Appendix B ToConcept and terminology In: Code display propagates to Concept.display; ToConcept accepts Code/List<Code>; null code argument in CodeSystem/ValueSet membership returns false
issues.root_cause: The ToConcept public helper wrapped arbitrary JSON dicts without Code validation or display propagation, and terminology membership lacked a static null-code guard before ValueSet/CodeSystem lowering.
issues.resolution: ToConcept validates Code shape, rejects Quantity-like objects, propagates Code.display to Concept.display, and null clinical membership in ValueSet/CodeSystem short-circuits to false.
issues.verified_in: CQL-02 probe; focused clinical/conversion pytest; native sqllogictest 776 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822
